style.backgroundSystem: deep cocoa brown #4A2A1D gradient for hero and trust screens, warm cream #F7F0DE for info screens, natural wood surfaces for scene shots

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium snack-food visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep cocoa brown #4A2A1D, warm cream #F7F0DE, wood tan #C9A876 and one caramel accent #B5722F; soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; friendly rounded sans-serif typography kept minimal; simple solid-circle badge icons only; appetizing natural food photography with the product always fresh and in sharp focus; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on or slight 3/4 product angle, centered placement, natural fresh food rendering with realistic shell and kernel texture
style.surfaceSystem: natural light-wood slice #C9A876 and matte cream board #F7F0DE
style.typography: friendly rounded sans-serif, minimal copy budget per screen
